title: Geometry of Newton homotopies: bivariate case
summary: A standard question in computational real algebraic geometry is to compute all real solutions to a system of polynomial equations with real coefficients. One classical and promising approach is to track along a connected component of a real curve defined by a Newton homotopy, which is dependent upon the selected start point. As the start point varies, different subsets of real solutions may be obtained.
